```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

diagnostic_file <- params$diagnostic_file

if (
  !is.character(diagnostic_file) ||
  length(diagnostic_file) != 1L ||
  is.na(diagnostic_file) ||
  !nzchar(trimws(diagnostic_file))
) {
  stop("The diagnostic_file parameter must contain one nonempty character file path.")
}

diagnostic_file <- path.expand(diagnostic_file)

if (!file.exists(diagnostic_file)) {
  stop("Diagnostic RDS file not found: ", diagnostic_file)
}

if (dir.exists(diagnostic_file)) {
  stop("The diagnostic_file parameter identifies a directory, not an RDS file: ", diagnostic_file)
}

diagnostic_file <- normalizePath(
  diagnostic_file,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

diagnostics <- readRDS(diagnostic_file)

if (!is.list(diagnostics)) {
  stop("The diagnostic RDS must contain a list.")
}

required_top_level_sections <- c(
  "hospitalization_level", "patient_procedure_load_qc", "intubation_identification",
  "tidal_volume_status_summary", "age_status_summary", "icu_status_summary",
  "age_eligible_tidal_volume_summary", "cumulative_filter_summary", "linkage_summary", "identifier_qc",
  "waterfall_retention_summary", "waterfall_process", "height", "weight", "clinical_data",
  "quality_checks_script02", "quality_checks_script03"
)

missing_top_level_sections <- setdiff(
  required_top_level_sections,
  names(diagnostics)
)

if (length(missing_top_level_sections) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The diagnostic RDS is missing required section(s): ",
    paste(missing_top_level_sections, collapse = ", "),
    ". Rerun Scripts 01, 02, and 03 in order."
  )
}

required_intubation_components <- c(
  "configuration", "processing_scope", "event_level", "identification_summary", "method_summary",
  "procedure_without_anchor", "initial_respiratory_state", "initially_invasive_anchor_validation",
  "icu_interval_summary", "transition_source_qc", "respiratory_timestamp_summary",
  "respiratory_timestamp_conflicts", "respiratory_conflict_patterns", "respiratory_resolution_summary",
  "integrity_checks", "one_hour_tidal_volume"
)


required_one_hour_components <- c(
  "configuration", "event_level", "overlap_summary", "overlap_detail", "source_summary",
  "support_state_join", "output_scope", "checks"
)

required_height_components <- c(
  "configuration", "hospitalization_level", "current_analytic_availability", "source_summary",
  "recovery_summary", "source_agreement", "source_disagreements", "supplemental_linkage",
  "supplemental_dispersion", "donor_datetime_qc", "donor_growth_plausibility", "checks"
)

find_missing_nested_components <- function(required_components, diagnostic_object, prefix) {
  missing_components <- setdiff(required_components, names(diagnostic_object))
  
  if (length(missing_components) == 0L) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  
  paste0(prefix, missing_components)
}

missing_nested_sections <- c(
  find_missing_nested_components(
    required_intubation_components,
    diagnostics$intubation_identification,
    "intubation_identification$"
  ),
  find_missing_nested_components(
    required_one_hour_components,
    diagnostics$intubation_identification$one_hour_tidal_volume,
    "intubation_identification$one_hour_tidal_volume$"
  ),
  find_missing_nested_components(required_height_components, diagnostics$height, "height$")
)

if (length(missing_nested_sections) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The diagnostic RDS is missing required nested section(s): ",
    paste(missing_nested_sections, collapse = ", "),
    ". Rerun Scripts 01, 02, and 03 in order."
  )
}

qc02 <- diagnostics$quality_checks_script02
qc03 <- diagnostics$quality_checks_script03

if (!is.list(qc02) || !is.list(qc03)) {
  stop("Script 02 and Script 03 diagnostic sections must be lists.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(qc03$metadata) || nrow(qc03$metadata) != 1L) {
  stop("Script 03 diagnostic metadata must contain exactly one row.")
}

required_script03_metadata <- c(
  "site", "generated_at", "overall_status", "note"
)

missing_script03_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_script03_metadata,
  names(qc03$metadata)
)

if (length(missing_script03_metadata) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Script 03 diagnostic metadata is missing column(s): ",
    paste(missing_script03_metadata, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

saved_site_name <- qc03$metadata$site[[1]]

if (
  !is.character(saved_site_name) ||
  length(saved_site_name) != 1L ||
  is.na(saved_site_name) ||
  !nzchar(trimws(saved_site_name))
) {
  stop("Script 03 diagnostic metadata must contain one nonempty character site label.")
}

report_site_name <- params$site_name

if (is.null(report_site_name)) {
  report_site_name <- saved_site_name
} else {
  if (
    !is.character(report_site_name) ||
    length(report_site_name) != 1L ||
    is.na(report_site_name) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(report_site_name))
  ) {
    stop("The site_name parameter must be null or one nonempty character site label.")
  }

  if (!identical(report_site_name, saved_site_name)) {
    stop(
      "Report site_name does not match the saved Script 03 diagnostics: ",
      report_site_name,
      " versus ",
      saved_site_name,
      "."
    )
  }
}

selected_tv_qc <- qc03$post_intubation_timepoints$selected_tidal_volume_cleaning

if (!is.list(selected_tv_qc)) {
  stop("Selected analytic tidal-volume cleaning diagnostics are missing. Rerun the updated Script 03.")
}

required_selected_tv_components <- c("policy", "thresholds", "summary", "hospitalization_level", "retention", "checks")
missing_selected_tv_components <- setdiff(required_selected_tv_components, names(selected_tv_qc))

if (length(missing_selected_tv_components) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Selected tidal-volume cleaning diagnostics are missing: ",
    paste(missing_selected_tv_components, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

show_table <- function(x, digits = 1, empty_text = "No records to display.") {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output("*Diagnostic not available.*\n\n"))
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  }

  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(
      knitr::asis_output(
        paste0("*", empty_text, "*\n\n")
      )
    )
  }

  knitr::kable(
    x,
    digits = digits,
    booktabs = knitr::is_latex_output(),
    longtable = knitr::is_latex_output() && nrow(x) > 30L
  )
}

show_note <- function(text) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(text, "\n\n"))
}
```

## Respiratory-anchor definition

Intubation anchors are identified independently of procedure-code 31500 presence.

A qualifying anchor is either:

- A documented transition from a known support state other than invasive to invasive support.
- For a hospitalization whose first known support state is invasive, the first directly documented invasive timestamp
  within an ICU interval.

ICU entry is inclusive and exit is exclusive. A missing ICU exit is filled from hospitalization discharge when available.
Intervals without a usable end are excluded from ICU-anchor matching.

Procedure-code presence is retained as hospitalization-level provenance. Billing timestamps do not anchor the
one-hour tidal-volume window.

## Supplemental-height configuration and linkage

Supplemental heights require linkage to a hospitalization. Rows with conflicting supplied patient identifiers,
or a supplied patient identifier that disagrees with the hospitalization lookup, are excluded from supplemental
height aggregation. Patient-only and unlinked measurements are retained in local diagnostics but are not used.

Plausible linked measurements are summarized by the median within each encounter. Index-hospitalization vitals
remain preferred over supplemental heights. Cross-encounter donor selection continues to use hospitalization
admission timestamps and the existing age-dependent windows.

Measurement-date values are retained as source text without parsing. Date precision and time-zone interpretation
remain unresolved; no measurement time is invented, and these values do not determine donor windows.

```{r}
#| label: supplemental-height-configuration

supplemental_qc <- diagnostics$supplemental_height

if (!is.list(supplemental_qc)) {
  stop("Supplemental-height diagnostics are missing. Complete the updated Script 01 before rendering.")
}

required_supplemental_components <- c(
  "configuration", "row_level", "linkage_summary", "checks"
)

missing_supplemental_components <- setdiff(
  required_supplemental_components,
  names(supplemental_qc)
)

if (length(missing_supplemental_components) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Supplemental-height diagnostics are missing component(s): ",
    paste(missing_supplemental_components, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

supplemental_configuration <- supplemental_qc$configuration

supplemental_configuration_report <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Source configured",
    "File available at source-selection check",
    "Source format",
    "Reader status",
    "Within-encounter reducer",
    "Measurement-date policy",
    "Donor timing"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(supplemental_configuration$configured),
    as.character(supplemental_configuration$available),
    coalesce(supplemental_configuration$format, "Not configured"),
    supplemental_configuration$reader_status,
    supplemental_configuration$within_encounter_reducer,
    supplemental_configuration$measurement_date_policy,
    supplemental_configuration$donor_timing
  )
)

show_table(supplemental_configuration_report)
```

# Script 02: Outlier cleaning and quality checks

This section compares hospitalization-level data availability before and after
outlier cleaning. Complete loss means that an index hospitalization had at
least one usable value before cleaning and no usable values afterward.

## Index-hospitalization ID checks

```{r}
show_table(qc02$cohort_id_qc)
```

## Post-intubation tidal-volume input


```{r}

```

## Combined availability and dropout

```{r}
combined_dropout_report <-
  qc02$combined_dropout_summary %>%
  transmute(
    Domain = data_domain,
    Element = str_replace_all(
      data_element,
      "_",
      " "
    ),
    `Index N` = n_index_hospitalizations,
    `Usable before` = n_with_usable_data_before,
    `Usable after` = n_with_usable_data_after,
    `Lost all` = n_lost_all_usable_data,
    `Lost (%)` =
      percent_lost_among_those_with_data_before
  )

show_table(
  combined_dropout_report
)
```

# Script 03: Variable derivation and final cohort

This section summarizes Script 03 quality checks and final-cohort derivation.
The diagnostic RDS retains hospitalization-level selected tidal-volume cleaning results. The tables in this
section summarize those results without displaying hospitalization identifiers.

Historical inclusion-rule sensitivity results may be present in the diagnostic RDS from an earlier workflow.
Their presence does not establish that they were regenerated for the current run, and this report does not
use them to determine the current cohort or quality-control status.

## Selected analytic tidal-volume cleaning

Script 01 inclusion requires a positive tidal volume during confirmed invasive support within one hour of a qualifying
respiratory anchor. Script 03 additionally applies source-specific tidal-volume thresholds to the originally selected
value before calculating normalized tidal volumes and respiratory mechanics.

Invalidated values become missing, but their rows and original sources are preserved. An invalidated set value is not
replaced with an observed value after cleaning. Timepoints without a usable cleaned value cannot pass the completeness
gate; a hospitalization can remain eligible through another complete timepoint.

## Script 03 cohort funnel

The funnel begins with hospitalizations having PBW and positive PFVC, then
requires a complete eligible invasive timepoint, and ends with hospitalizations
having a complete eligible invasive timepoint meeting at least one hypoxemia
criterion: OI ≥ 4, OSI ≥ 5, PF ratio ≤ 300, or SF ratio ≤ 250. VT/PBW remains
an analytic variable and is not restricted to 4–8 mL/kg for eligibility.

```{r}
if (is.null(qc03)) {
  cat("*Script 03 cohort funnel is not available.*")
} else {
  script03_funnel_report <- qc03$cohort_funnel %>%
    transmute(
      Step = filter_step,
      `Hospitalizations remaining` =
        n_hospitalizations,
      `Removed at step` =
        n_removed_at_step,
      `Retained from previous step (%)` =
        percent_retained_from_previous_step,
      `Retained from PBW/PFVC cohort (%)` =
        percent_retained_from_pbw_pfvc
    )

  show_table(
    script03_funnel_report
  )
}
```

## Height-bin coverage

These diagnostics assess height-group assignment in the final cross-sectional cohort before
distribution-export group filtering. Bin intervals include their lower boundary and exclude their upper boundary.

The lower extension covers 80 to under 92 cm. The upper extension covers accepted heights from 182 through
200 cm within the final open-ended bin. Coverage does not mean that every group was exported or that every
histogram cell meets an approved disclosure policy.

## Daily respiratory pSOFA: measured and imputed oxygenation

Respiratory pediatric Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (pSOFA) scoring uses the measured arterial
oxygen partial pressure-to-inspired oxygen fraction ratio (PF ratio) when available. An oxygen-saturation-imputed
PF ratio is used only when the measured ratio is unavailable. Unavailable respiratory scores retain the existing
zero-fill rule.

The measured-only comparison below holds all other organ scores fixed. It isolates the respiratory fallback
change; it does not estimate the combined effect of earlier laboratory cleaning or other pipeline changes.

Inputs retain the existing admission-relative daily extrema. These diagnostics do not introduce newly
time-matched oxygen-saturation and inspired-oxygen measurements.

# Automated warnings

```{r}
#| results: asis

report_warnings <- character()

append_integrity_warning <- function(warnings, checks, label) {
  if (
    !is.data.frame(checks) ||
    !all(c("check", "passed") %in% names(checks)) ||
    !is.logical(checks$passed) ||
    nrow(checks) == 0L
  ) {
    return(c(warnings, paste0(label, ": integrity-check results are missing or malformed.")))
  }

  failed <- is.na(checks$passed) | !checks$passed

  if (any(failed)) {
    failed_names <- as.character(checks$check[failed])
    failed_names[is.na(failed_names) | !nzchar(trimws(failed_names))] <- "Unnamed check"

    warnings <- c(
      warnings,
      paste0(
        label,
        ": failed or indeterminate check(s): ",
        paste(failed_names, collapse = ", "),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  warnings
}

report_warnings <- append_integrity_warning(
  warnings = report_warnings,
  checks = supplemental_qc$checks,
  label = "Supplemental height"
)

report_warnings <- append_integrity_warning(
  warnings = report_warnings,
  checks = respiratory_psofa_qc$checks,
  label = "Daily respiratory pSOFA"
)

report_warnings <- append_integrity_warning(
  warnings = report_warnings,
  checks = height_bin_qc$checks,
  label = "Height-bin coverage"
)

if (
  isTRUE(supplemental_qc$configuration$configured) &&
  identical(
    supplemental_qc$configuration$reader_status,
    "Configured supplemental height file unavailable"
  )
) {
  report_warnings <- c(
    report_warnings,
    "The configured supplemental height file was unavailable; supplemental heights were not used."
  )
}

intubation_checks <- diagnostics$intubation_identification$integrity_checks

if (!is.null(intubation_checks) && any(!intubation_checks$passed, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  failed_intubation_checks <- intubation_checks %>%
    filter(!passed) %>%
    pull(check)
  
  report_warnings <- c(
    report_warnings,
    paste0("Intubation-identification check(s) failed: ", paste(failed_intubation_checks, collapse = ", "), ".")
  )
}

one_hour_checks <- diagnostics$intubation_identification$one_hour_tidal_volume$checks

if (!is.null(one_hour_checks) && any(!one_hour_checks$passed, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  failed_one_hour_checks <- one_hour_checks %>%
    filter(!passed) %>%
    pull(check)
  
  report_warnings <- c(
    report_warnings,
    paste0("One-hour tidal-volume check(s) failed: ", paste(failed_one_hour_checks, collapse = ", "), ".")
  )
}

waterfall_summary <-
  diagnostics$waterfall_retention_summary

if (
  !is.null(waterfall_summary) &&
  any(
    waterfall_summary$waterfall_status ==
      "No waterfall output"
  )
) {
  report_warnings <- c(
    report_warnings,
    "At least one hospitalization has no respiratory-waterfall output."
  )
}

height_checks <- diagnostics$height$checks

if (!is.null(height_checks) && any(!height_checks$passed, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  failed_height_checks <- height_checks %>%
    filter(!passed) %>%
    pull(check)

    report_warnings,
    paste0("Height integrity check(s) failed: ", paste(failed_height_checks, collapse = ", "), ".")
  )
}

weight_summary <-
  diagnostics$weight$availability_summary

if (
  !is.null(weight_summary) &&
  any(
    weight_summary$weight_status ==
      "Unexpected processing loss"
  )
) {
  report_warnings <- c(
    report_warnings,
    "Unexpected processing loss was identified for weight."
  )
}

clinical_quality <-
  diagnostics$clinical_data$quality_summary

if (
  !is.null(clinical_quality) &&

) {

      clinical_quality$n_without_demographics,

    )

}

if (
  !is.null(clinical_quality) &&
  clinical_quality$n_missing_discharge_category > 0
) {

    report_warnings,
    paste0(
      clinical_quality$n_missing_discharge_category,
      " hospitalization(s) have a missing discharge category."
    )

}

# Script 02 warnings
if (!is.null(qc02)) {
  
  # Warn when cleaning caused complete loss of a data element
  combined_dropout <-
    qc02$combined_dropout_summary
  
  if (
    !is.null(combined_dropout) &&
      any(
        combined_dropout$
          n_lost_all_usable_data > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) {
    total_complete_losses <- sum(
      combined_dropout$
        n_lost_all_usable_data,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    affected_data_elements <- sum(
      combined_dropout$
        n_lost_all_usable_data > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      paste0(
        total_complete_losses,
        " hospitalization–data-element combinations across ",
        affected_data_elements,
        " data element(s) lost all usable data during ",
        "Script 02 cleaning."
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Report exact duplicate vital rows removed before cleaning
  vital_integrity <-
    qc02$vitals$integrity_summary
  
  if (!is.null(vital_integrity)) {
    vital_duplicates_removed <-
      vital_integrity %>%
      filter(
        diagnostic ==
          "Exact duplicate vital rows removed"
      ) %>%
      pull(n)
    
    if (
      length(vital_duplicates_removed) == 1 &&
        vital_duplicates_removed > 0
    ) {
      report_warnings <- c(
        report_warnings,
        paste0(
          format(
            vital_duplicates_removed,
            big.mark = ","
          ),
          " exact duplicate vital rows were removed ",
          "before threshold cleaning."
        )
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Flag the possible mixed-unit set tidal-volume pattern
  tidal_unit_summary <-
    qc02$respiratory_support$
      tidal_volume_complete_loss$
      summary
  
  if (
    !is.null(tidal_unit_summary) &&
      nrow(tidal_unit_summary) > 0 &&
      tidal_unit_summary$
        n_consistent_with_ml_per_kg_mapping > 0
  ) {
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      paste0(
        tidal_unit_summary$
          n_consistent_with_ml_per_kg_mapping,
        " hospitalization(s) losing all set tidal-volume data ",
        "showed a pattern consistent with possible mL/kg values ",
        "in a field expected to contain absolute mL."
      )
    )
  }
}

# Script 03 warnings
if (!is.null(qc03)) {

  if (!isTRUE(all(selected_tv_qc$checks$passed))) {
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      "At least one selected analytic tidal-volume cleaning integrity check did not pass."
    )
  }

  n_selected_tv_losses <- selected_tv_qc$retention$n_lost_all_selected_volume

  if (length(n_selected_tv_losses) == 1L && !is.na(n_selected_tv_losses) && n_selected_tv_losses > 0L) {
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      paste0(
        n_selected_tv_losses,
        " hospitalization(s) lost all selected one-hour tidal-volume values during Script 03 cleaning."
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Flag an overall Script 03 QC failure.
  script03_overall_status <-
    qc03$metadata$overall_status
  
  if (
    length(script03_overall_status) == 1 &&
      !is.na(script03_overall_status) &&
      script03_overall_status != "PASS"
  ) {
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      paste0(
        "Script 03 overall QC status is ",
        script03_overall_status,
        ". Review the Script 03 QC summary."
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Identify individual Script 03 checks marked for review.
  script03_review_items <- qc03$summary %>%
    filter(
      status == "REVIEW"
    ) %>%
    pull(qc_area)
  
  if (length(script03_review_items) > 0) {
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      paste0(
        "Script 03 check(s) requiring review: ",
        paste(
          script03_review_items,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "."
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Funnel counts must agree with their independent calculations.
  script03_reconciliation <-
    qc03$funnel_reconciliation
  
  if (
    !is.null(script03_reconciliation) &&
      any(
        !script03_reconciliation$counts_agree,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) {
    failed_checkpoints <-
      script03_reconciliation %>%
      filter(
        !counts_agree
      ) %>%
      pull(checkpoint)
    
    report_warnings <- c(
      report_warnings,
      paste0(
        "Script 03 funnel reconciliation failed at: ",
        paste(
          failed_checkpoints,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "."
      )
    )
  }
}

if (length(report_warnings) == 0) {
  cat("No automated processing warnings were identified.")
} else {
  cat(
    paste0("- ", report_warnings),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
    paste(names(diagnostics), collapse = ", "),
    qc03$metadata$generated_at[[1]],
    qc03$metadata$overall_status[[1]],
    qc03$metadata$note[[1]],
    as.character(Sys.time()),
    R.version.string,
    as.character(quarto::quarto_version())
  )
)

show_table(reproducibility)
```
